theorem QOU.BraidKnot.OVBaseSeminormalVector.exists_collision_earlier_col {μ : YoungDiagram} (t : Specht.Tableau μ) {c c' : ℕ} (hcc : c < c') {s : Fin (Specht.nOf μ)} (hs : Specht.colPattern t s = c') :
∃ (x : Fin (Specht.nOf μ)), x ≠ s ∧ Specht.colPattern t x = c ∧ Specht.rowPattern t x = Specht.rowPattern t s

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.OVBaseSeminormalVector.exists_sameRow_earlier_col {μ : YoungDiagram} (t : Specht.Tableau μ) {c c' : ℕ} (hcc : c ≤ c') {s : Fin (Specht.nOf μ)} (hs : Specht.colPattern t s = c') :
∃ (x : Fin (Specht.nOf μ)), Specht.colPattern t x = c ∧ Specht.rowPattern t x = Specht.rowPattern t s

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.OVBaseSeminormalVector.colLabels_smul_of_mem_colStab {μ : YoungDiagram} (c : ℕ) {t : Specht.Tableau μ} {ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (Specht.nOf μ))} (hρ : ρ ∈ Specht.colStab t) :
{l : Fin (Specht.nOf μ) | Specht.colPattern (ρ • t) l = c} = {l : Fin (Specht.nOf μ) | Specht.colPattern t l = c}

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.OVBaseSeminormalVector.colPattern_smul_of_mem_colStab {μ : YoungDiagram} {t : Specht.Tableau μ} {ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (Specht.nOf μ))} (hρ : ρ ∈ Specht.colStab t) :
Specht.colPattern (ρ • t) = Specht.colPattern t

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.OVBaseSeminormalVector.jm_polytabloid_split {k : Type} [CommRing k] {μ : YoungDiagram} (s : Fin (Specht.nOf μ)) (t : Specht.Tableau μ) :
((Specht.Mtab.rep μ).asAlgebraHom (JucysMurphy.jucysMurphy (Specht.nOf μ) s)) (Specht.polytabloid t) = {j : Fin (Specht.nOf μ) | ↑j < ↑s ∧ Equiv.swap j s ∈ Specht.colStab t}.card • -Specht.polytabloid t + ∑ j : Fin (Specht.nOf μ) with ↑j < ↑s ∧ Equiv.swap j s ∉ Specht.colStab t, Specht.polytabloid (Equiv.swap j s • t)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.OVBaseSeminormalVector.sameColumn_sum_polytabloid {k : Type} [CommRing k] {μ : YoungDiagram} (s : Fin (Specht.nOf μ)) (t : Specht.Tableau μ) :
∑ j : Fin (Specht.nOf μ) with ↑j < ↑s ∧ Equiv.swap j s ∈ Specht.colStab t, Specht.polytabloid (Equiv.swap j s • t) = {j : Fin (Specht.nOf μ) | ↑j < ↑s ∧ Equiv.swap j s ∈ Specht.colStab t}.card • -Specht.polytabloid t

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.OVBaseSeminormalVector.colGarnir_single_column_of_annihilation {k : Type} [Field k] [CharZero k] {μ : YoungDiagram} (t : Specht.Tableau μ) (C : Finset (Fin (Specht.nOf μ))) (s : Fin (Specht.nOf μ)) (hs : s ∉ C) (hCcol : ∀ π ∈ permFixingOutside C, π ∈ Specht.colStab t) (hann : ∑ σ ∈ permFixingOutside (insert s C), ↑(Equiv.Perm.sign σ) • ((Specht.Mtab.rep μ) σ) (Specht.polytabloid t) = 0) :
∑ j ∈ C, Specht.polytabloid (Equiv.swap j s • t) = Specht.polytabloid t

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.OVBaseSeminormalVector.colGarnir_fullgroup_sum {k : Type} [CommRing k] {μ : YoungDiagram} (t : Specht.Tableau μ) (C : Finset (Fin (Specht.nOf μ))) (s : Fin (Specht.nOf μ)) (hs : s ∉ C) (hCcol : ∀ π ∈ permFixingOutside C, π ∈ Specht.colStab t) :
∑ σ ∈ permFixingOutside (insert s C), ↑(Equiv.Perm.sign σ) • ((Specht.Mtab.rep μ) σ) (Specht.polytabloid t) = (permFixingOutside C).card • (Specht.polytabloid t - ∑ j ∈ C, Specht.polytabloid (Equiv.swap j s • t))

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.OVBaseSeminormalVector.mem_permFixingOutside {μ : YoungDiagram} {D : Finset (Fin (Specht.nOf μ))} {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (Specht.nOf μ))} :
σ ∈ permFixingOutside D ↔ ∀ l ∉ D, σ l = l

def QOU.BraidKnot.OVBaseSeminormalVector.permFixingOutside {μ : YoungDiagram} (D : Finset (Fin (Specht.nOf μ))) :
Finset (Equiv.Perm (Fin (Specht.nOf μ)))

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.OVBaseSeminormalVector.starSum_rep_polytabloid {k : Type} [CommRing k] {μ : YoungDiagram} (t : Specht.Tableau μ) (C : Finset (Fin (Specht.nOf μ))) (s : Fin (Specht.nOf μ)) (hs : s ∉ C) :
∑ x ∈ insert s C, ↑(Equiv.Perm.sign (Equiv.swap x s)) • ((Specht.Mtab.rep μ) (Equiv.swap x s)) (Specht.polytabloid t) = Specht.polytabloid t - ∑ j ∈ C, Specht.polytabloid (Equiv.swap j s • t)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.OVBaseSeminormalVector.colStab_subset_sum_rep_polytabloid {k : Type} [CommRing k] {μ : YoungDiagram} (t : Specht.Tableau μ) (H : Finset (Equiv.Perm (Fin (Specht.nOf μ)))) (hH : ∀ σ ∈ H, σ ∈ Specht.colStab t) :
∑ σ ∈ H, ↑(Equiv.Perm.sign σ) • ((Specht.Mtab.rep μ) σ) (Specht.polytabloid t) = H.card • Specht.polytabloid t

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.OVBaseSeminormalVector.polytabloid_swap_colStab {k : Type} [CommRing k] {μ : YoungDiagram} (t : Specht.Tableau μ) {j s : Fin (Specht.nOf μ)} (hjs : j ≠ s) (hmem : Equiv.swap j s ∈ Specht.colStab t) :
Specht.polytabloid (Equiv.swap j s • t) = -Specht.polytabloid t

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.OVBaseSeminormalVector.rep_colStab_polytabloid {k : Type} [CommRing k] {μ : YoungDiagram} (t : Specht.Tableau μ) {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (Specht.nOf μ))} (hσ : σ ∈ Specht.colStab t) :
((Specht.Mtab.rep μ) σ) (Specht.polytabloid t) = ↑(Equiv.Perm.sign σ) • Specht.polytabloid t

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.OVBaseSeminormalVector.jm_smul_polytabloid {k : Type} [CommRing k] {μ : YoungDiagram} (s : Fin (Specht.nOf μ)) (t : Specht.Tableau μ) :
((Specht.Mtab.rep μ).asAlgebraHom (JucysMurphy.jucysMurphy (Specht.nOf μ) s)) (Specht.polytabloid t) = ∑ j : Fin (Specht.nOf μ) with ↑j < ↑s, Specht.polytabloid (Equiv.swap j s • t)
